title: ALL removes every filter on a table except a role's
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "All", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], ALL ( Customer ) ) )

source.quote: In other words, when ALL ( Customer ) is executed, ALL removes all the filters from the Customer table except for the security filters.
source.supports: the role's filter on Customer survives ALL ( Customer )

derivation: Europe keeps Ann and Bob; ALL ( Customer ) can't remove that, so the amount is that of their sales: 100 + 20 + 10 = 130, not the 210 of all sales.
